title: Stab in the Dark
summary: The owner of a rum distillery is found stabbed during a seance.
method: The victim and killer had a plan to fake some supernatural occurrences during the seance, so that the others would think the seance did something. The victim let the killer hide in the room while the seance was taking place.
motive: The victim was going to tear down an old building which contained the body of the killer's wife, whom he killed 15 years prior after discovering her affair with the victim.
notes:
Andre Morgan is played by the same actor who plays DI Wilson later on.
First appearance of Florence. She's not really given a backstory. She's a sergeant but they've never established she lives anywhere else except on the island but yet she hasn't been a part of the police force. Also, the Commissioner had to help out in this episode but Florence was already on the island because she was at Catherine's Bar.
Dwayne calls Fidel and wishes him well. DI Goodman mentions he moved to Saint Lucia.
